aggregateTreeIncludes: Packet, phase streams/reports/bindings, writable runtime configs and cache/temp at each phase boundary. Controller streams are added after worker: up to16MiB; outer recorder streams up to16MiB. Thus conservative total288MiB, not272MiB.
overflowDisposition: STOP, no time/disk/output waiver or partial fixture acceptance
treeBoundaryVersusLiveFloor: Output tree byte/entry bound is audited at each phase boundary; unrelated or transient growth remains subject to original live3GiB disk-floor guards, which can STOP before the tree audit.
